project_spec.name: Tsugi (次)
project_spec.overview: Tsugi (次) is a fast, ultra-modern, edge-ready anime and manga recommendation app built for speed. The primary goal is to let users generate and share a recommendation link in under 10 seconds without unnecessary friction.

core_mission.principle: Zero-friction creation: Minimal clicks to go from search -> selection -> share link.
Instant sharing: Auto-copy share link to clipboard upon creation with ready-to-share social buttons (Twitter/X, Discord, WhatsApp).
Rich previews: Every generated link (e.g. tsugi.app/r/a9Xk2L8q) MUST render a stunning social image preview (@vercel/og) when posted anywhere online.

tech_stack.authentication: Better-Auth with GitHub OAuth & Drizzle Adapter

requirement.title: Quick-Share UX & DaisyUI Components
requirement.description: Design the homepage (`src/app/page.tsx`) around a lightning-fast recommendation flow: 1. Instant live search input for Anime/Manga. 2. Quick score picker (1-10 rating badges) and an optional 280-char comment field. 3. One-click "Generate Share Link" action that instantly pops up a DaisyUI modal containing the unique URL, a "Copy Link" button, and 1-click share buttons for Twitter/X and WhatsApp.

requirement.title: Styling & Aesthetic
requirement.description: Install and configure `daisyui` plugin in `tailwind.config.ts`. Use dark mode DaisyUI themes (`dark`, `night`, or `dim`) with vibrant accent colors for high visual punch.

requirement.title: Database Schema (Drizzle ORM)
requirement.description: Define schema in `src/db/schema.ts` including Better-Auth tables (`user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`) and the `recommendation` table with fields: `id`, `slug` (varchar 12, unique), `title`, `mediaType` (enum: anime/manga), `externalId`, `coverImage`, `score` (integer), `comment`, `views` (integer default 0), `userId` (nullable foreign key), `createdAt`.

requirement.title: Dual Search Media Service
requirement.description: Implement `src/server/services/media.ts` with a unified return type `UnifiedMediaResult`. Allow searching via AniList GraphQL (primary) and Jikan REST API (fallback). Include auto-fallback handling if the primary provider throws an error.

requirement.title: Hono API & Upstash Rate Limiting
requirement.description: Mount Hono at `src/app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts`. Implement Upstash Redis rate-limiting middleware in `src/server/hono/middleware.ts` restricting POST requests on `/api/recs` to 5 requests per minute per IP. Handle creation of recommendations with Nanoid slug generation and retrieval of recommendations by slug (incrementing view count).

requirement.title: Dynamic OG Social Cards
requirement.description: Implement `src/app/r/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx` using `@vercel/og` with Edge runtime. Generate a 1200x630 PNG displaying the media cover image, title, media type, score, user review quote, and Tsugi branding.

requirement.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
requirement.description: Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` using `oven-sh/setup-bun` action to run linting and TypeScript compilation (`bun x tsc --noEmit`) on every push/PR to main.

project_spec.execution_instructions: 1. Initialize the project dependencies: `bun add hono @hono/zod-validator better-auth drizzle-orm postgres zod nanoid @vercel/og @upstash/ratelimit @upstash/redis` `bun add -d daisyui@latest drizzle-kit typescript @types/node` 2. Configure `tailwind.config.ts` to include `require('daisyui')` in plugins and select dark themes (`night`/`dim`). 3. Create `src/db/schema.ts` and `src/db/index.ts` configured for Supabase Transaction Pooler. 4. Build `src/lib/types/media.ts` and `src/server/services/media.ts` for dual-provider searching. 5. Set up `src/server/hono/middleware.ts` and the main Hono catch-all route handler. 6. Build the dynamic OG image generator (`src/app/r/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx`) and public recommendation view page (`src/app/r/[slug]/page.tsx`). 7. Build the fast creation flow (`src/components/QuickRecForm.tsx` & `src/components/ShareModal.tsx`). 8. Ensure clean type safety, zero ESLint errors, and full TypeScript compliance.
